title: Snowball Showdown Cash Bingo on Wednesday 18 November
preheader: Ten games, £10 cash per book, 7pm start. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Ten games and a growing jackpot
body: Ten games, a mixture of prizes, a rollover Snowball and a final cash jackpot that grows with every book sold. Half of every book goes straight into that jackpot, so £5 from each book is added to the final prize.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Bingo books cost £10 each, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Snowball Showdown Cash Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: About the Snowball
body: The Game 9 Snowball is projected at £180 for a full house within 58 numbers. That projection depends on it staying unclaimed at the earlier Cash Bingo nights, and if it is won the amount and the number target are updated before this one.
To play for the Snowball you need to have attended one of the previous three Cash Bingo nights. That condition applies to the Snowball, not to the final cash jackpot.

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Communal tables, book your group together

data.heading: Everyone settled before eyes down
body: Numbers appear on the pub TVs, so beginners can follow along easily. Dabbers are available to buy at the bar.
18+ to play. Supervised under-18s are welcome to attend but may not play. Include everyone attending in your booking.

data.body: Who is joining you? Book your group together and we will get your seats ready.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
